name: calcvisual
description: An interactive math visualizer and scientific calculator that runs in one HTML file. Type an equation and it is drawn in 2D or 3D as you type, with a live analysis of derivatives, gradients, divergence, curl, and critical points. It is built for students: it works on phones, tablets and PCs, with pinch zoom, a draggable calculator panel, and a symbol row for hard-to-type characters.
